label: EMAIL TIP
headline: Focus on One Clear Action
body: Tell your readers exactly what to do next to avoid confusion and get more clicks.
caption:
Ever sent an email with multiple links or ideas, hoping one would stick? It's easy to overwhelm your audience. When your email has one clear purpose and one main thing you want people to do, it makes their decision simple.
